subject: Startups
title: Retention Curves
description: A fast breakdown of Retention Curves for builders.

hook.text: A retention curve shows what percentage of users come back after day 1, day 7, day 30, and beyond.

buildup.text: Most apps lose 75% of users within the first week. The best consumer apps retain 25–35% at day 30.

discovery.text: A 'smiling curve' flattens into a stable floor—users who stay forever. That floor is your real user base.

twist.text: A 'frowning curve' keeps dropping and never stabilizes. No matter how many users you acquire, they all leave.

climax.text: Before spending on growth, check the retention curve. Pouring users into a leaky bucket just wets the floor.

punchline.text: Retention shows if the product itself works. Growth amplifies it.

quiz.question: What does a 'smiling' retention curve indicate?
options: Retention stabilizes into a healthy long-term floor
The app has too many features
